name: ffquintella-bastionvault
author: Felipe Quintella
summary: Install and run BastionVault server rootlessly via Podman Quadlet on EL9/EL10.
description: Puppet module to install and configure the BastionVault server (Vault-API compatible secrets manager) using rootless Podman with SELinux enforcing and systemd cgroups v2 limits. Supports single-node and HA (hiqlite Raft) topologies. Initialization and unseal are intentionally out of scope and remain a manual operator task.
